usage: python benham.py <command> [args...]

  send          enqueue a message for the running bot to deliver
  dm            enqueue a DM for the running bot to deliver
  draft         draft a reply for review BEFORE it goes to a friend
  do            run any registered capability from the shell
  fetch         pull recent messages from a channel via the bot
  delete        delete ONE message by id (previews, then --confirm-token)
  purge         bulk-delete a channel by age (previews, then --confirm-token)
  catchup       invisible, read-only catch-up on one channel
  read_history  invisible, read-only reader across guilds
  ask           ask Tyler something and wait for his answer
  initiate      Claude reaching out to Tyler FIRST - the daily job's surface
  outreach      ask a whitelisted COLLABORATOR something (never Tyler)
  conv          read, close or bank conversations
  rooms         list rooms: names + unread counts, nothing else
  room          read / post into / create one room
  status        quick, read-only health check
  usage         token and cost accounting from the logs
  inbox         the last N messages the bot saw (--dms for DMs only)
  restart       ask the running bot to exit; its supervisor brings it back
  webhook       post via a saved webhook / manage webhooks
  guest         guest chat admin: status | forget <user_id> | forget-all | off
  ideas         guest ideas inbox: new since sweep | --all | --sweep
  issues        intake tracker: list | loop (close the loop) | retry

  <command> --help usually prints that command's own usage.
  The bot process itself is separate:  python -u -m benham.bot
